faq_heading: Homes near Goldstone Park Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Goldstone Park Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Goldstone Park Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Goldstone Park Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Goldstone Park Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Sullivan Heights Secondary (0.4 km west), McLeod Road Traditional (0.8 km west) and Woodward Hill Elementary (0.8 km south-west).

How the Goldstone Park Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Goldstone Park Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Goldstone Park Elementary

16 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Goldstone Park Elementary in a straight line (12 elementary, 3 secondary, 1 other; 3 independent). The closest is Sullivan Heights Secondary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is St Bernadette, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is McLeod Road Traditional (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is Regent Christian Academy (1.3 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (2.7 km). Other elementary schools close by: McLeod Road Traditional (0.8 km west), Woodward Hill Elementary (0.8 km south-west), Cambridge Elementary (0.9 km east), Sullivan Elementary (1.4 km east), Hyland Elementary (1.4 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is McLeod Road Traditional, 0.8 km west of Goldstone Park Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Goldstone Park Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Goldstone Park Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Goldstone Park Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.
Look at McLeod Road Traditional, the nearest other elementary school, 0.8 km west of Goldstone Park Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
